title: Uvavanyo Lomphefumlo Ohlala Ehleli
intro: Umphefumlo umi ngexesha lovavanyo oluvela kuThixo, ufuna ulwalathiso ngokuzithoba. Lowo wazi konke uyamgxotha lo mfuni, aze atyhile kamva ukuba oku yayiluvavanyo lwentliziyo. Ngale ngxoxo ingaqondakaliyo, isifundo malunga nobulumko bukaThixo siyavela phambi kwabo bacingayo. Ungamfumana lo mntu kwibali leQuran?
clues: Ndifune ulwazi nesikhokelo kumthunywa othandekayo ka-Allah
Ndize ndifuna inyaniso, ndibiza uMprofeti ngomnqweno onyanisekileyo
Ndakhalinyelwa ndaza ndajikwa, kuba ubulumko buka-Allah babunezinye izicwangciso ngelo xesha.
Kodwa andizange ndiphelelwe lithemba—endaweni yoko, ndaqhubeka nokufuna kwam
Lowo waziyo yonke into wathi oku luvavanyo lwentliziyo kunye nesilumkiso
Ndandingomnye wabo iQuran ityhila ngabo: 'Wafinga ubuso waza wajika, kuba kwafika kuye indoda eyimfama'
